profile.headline: Full-Stack & Technical Solutions Engineer — IAM, Cybersecurity, Automation
profile.lead: Engineer spanning full-stack product ownership, identity integrations, enterprise infrastructure, and L3 support. Built customer-facing and internal platforms, operated user lifecycles across 50+ SaaS products, and automated secure workflows.
profile.education: Computer engineering, Polytechnique Montréal · Full-stack certificate
profile.volunteering: Magen David Adom · Police cadet · Firefighter

cyolo.title: Full-stack, IAM, L3 support & IT automation
cyolo.summary: Owned customer and internal products, identity integrations, infrastructure, automation, and complex enterprise troubleshooting.
body: Designed, built, and owned Cyolo Helpdesk from scratch, a customer-facing React, Redux, Node.js, REST, Docker/PWA, and RBAC add-on used to manage user lifecycles, applications, and vaults.
Delivered the Cyolo Back-Office frontend independently and contributed to its backend architecture, centralizing tenant, license, and certificate management for internal teams and partners.
Managed identity integrations and user lifecycles across 50+ SaaS platforms through SSO, SAML, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP/LDAPS, Entra ID, and Okta.
Built QA and R&D tools for SAML/OIDC identity-provider testing and HTTP/HTTPS request inspection, packaged with Docker Compose.

Managed and secured enterprise IT environments with Microsoft 365, Intune, Microsoft XDR, Fortinet, and virtualization; automated operations in PowerShell, Python, and Shell and supported SOC 2 readiness.

Delivered advanced L2/L3 support across SaaS, on-prem, DMZ, and multi-site deployments, resolving identity, network, proxy, certificate, Docker, and remote-access issues across Linux, Windows, and macOS.

robotika.title: Software and hardware projects — freelance
robotika.summary: Hardware and software integration on client projects: RFID, Arduino, automation.
body: Built an RFID-to-barcode pipeline that reads tags embedded in footwear and feeds a brand-facing website.
Engineered a door intruder alarm on Arduino Portenta H7 and Nicla with a voice sensor — hardware and software integration for a security use case.
Delivered file-movement automation, Arduino-driven video playback control, and a G-code pen plotter, with 3D-printed parts for robotic assemblies.

idf.title: Technical support engineer — tier 2, staff sergeant
idf.summary: 24/7 support across network, software, and hardware for an operational unit.
body: Held a 24/7 tier-2 desk as staff sergeant: incidents, coordination with specialists, and uptime of local systems.
Certified in computer network management by the Air Force in 2020.
Maintained network, video, audio, and electrical cabling when the job required it.

idp-lab.title: SAML/OIDC test harness
idp-lab.summary: An identity-provider testing tool built for QA and R&D.
body: Built a full-stack tool that stands up SaaS identity-provider integrations, so QA and R&D can exercise SAML and OIDC flows without waiting on a customer tenant.
Containerized and deployable with Docker Compose, which is what made it usable by people other than me.

identity.title: Identity integrations
identity.summary: SAML, SCIM, SSO, and LDAP — IdP to product.
body: Connect identity providers to a Zero Trust product: SAML, SCIM, SSO, and LDAP, plus the certificate lifecycle around them.
Troubleshoot credential vaulting and session brokering on customer deployments.
Published a SAML SSO template (React, Express, Docker) for Entra-style providers as a public reference.

ops-platform.title: Back-Office — tenants and licenses
ops-platform.summary: Internal platform for employees and partners.
body: Designed and delivered the frontend end to end, and contributed to the backend architecture, for the platform employees and partners use to manage customer tenants and licenses.
Added tenant insight, license and certificate management, and in-app decoders for TLS and SAN certificates and license data.

helpdesk.title: Helpdesk — customer add-on
helpdesk.summary: User lifecycle, vaults, and RBAC — React, Redux, Node, Docker.
body: Built from scratch an add-on to the core product, so customer helpdesk admins manage user lifecycles, categories, applications, and vaults, with full RBAC and REST APIs.
Own its documentation, releases, and ongoing support for the admins who run it.

web-forge.title: HTTP inspection tool
web-forge.summary: Header and body inspection and manipulation for HTTP/HTTPS apps.
body: Built a tool that inspects and rewrites request and response headers and bodies, so support and R&D can see what a proxy or a policy is actually doing to traffic.
Containerized alongside the rest of the test stack and deployable with Docker Compose.

xdr.title: Defender XDR rollout
xdr.summary: Endpoint detection taken company-wide, evaluation through production.
body: Deployed Microsoft Defender and XDR across the estate single-handed, from evaluation through to production.
Hardened systems and access policies alongside it, improving security posture and audit readiness under SOC 2.

it-automation.title: IT automation
it-automation.summary: Onboarding, offboarding, and monitoring in PowerShell, Python, and Shell.
body: Automated joiner, mover, and leaver flows across 50+ SaaS platforms, so account creation and revocation stopped depending on someone remembering.
Wrote the diagnostic and monitoring scripts support runs day to day.

ai-workflows.title: AI-assisted workflows
ai-workflows.summary: LLM integrations, reusable workflows, and focused MVPs.
body: Integrated language models into applications and operational workflows, and built focused AI-powered MVPs to reduce manual work.
Designed reusable workflows, skills, rules, and structured instructions so AI-assisted processes produce more consistent results.
